title: Os 80 desafios
body:
Ficam no menu Progress. Marque aqui o que já fez. * = sem morrer nem ser preso.
- **Fáceis de fazer cedo:** Gym Member, Mugging, Vehicle Discovery, WAiNK Locations, Basketball Rookie, Alligator Kills.
- **Planeje:** Nest Egg (US$ 1,5 milhão na conta corrente), Pro Angler ([[mundo-pesca]]), Legendary Hunter, Basketball Pro ([[colecao-cestas]]) e Helipad Flyovers.
- **Deixe para depois do Cap. 3:** Heavily Armed (mais de US$ 50 mil gastos na Ammu-Nation) e Stylishly Armed (cosméticos em 5 armas curtas e 5 longas).
- **Vendas para os 100%** (narcóticos, joias, notas marcadas, veículos) não são desafios: as metas estão em [[colecao-100]].

en.title: The 80 challenges
en.body:
They live in the Progress menu. Tick what you've done. * = without dying or being arrested.
- **Easy early:** Gym Member, Mugging, Vehicle Discovery, WAiNK Locations, Basketball Rookie, Alligator Kills.
- **Plan ahead:** Nest Egg ($1.5 million in checking), Pro Angler ([[mundo-pesca]]), Legendary Hunter, Basketball Pro ([[colecao-cestas]]) and Helipad Flyovers.
- **Leave until after Ch. 3:** Heavily Armed (over $50k spent at Ammu-Nation) and Stylishly Armed (cosmetics on 5 sidearms and 5 longarms).
- **Sales for 100%** (narcotics, jewelry, marked bills, vehicles) aren't challenges: the targets are in [[colecao-100]].

en.div: Nest Egg: the challenge text (IGN) asks for $1.5 million in the BuckMe checking account; PowerPyx says $1.5 million in savings. This guide follows the challenge text.
